BMLD.description: Beam Detail Analysis (BMLD). Runs the Beam Detail Analysis of one beam element for one load case/combination and returns displacement (Dy/Dz), shear (Fy/Fz), bending moment (My/Mz), longitudinal and cross-section stress, and applied force/moment results, each evaluated at the I-end, J-end, max/min positions and the requested ELEM_POS_RATIO. Driven by LOAD_CASE_COMB (which result to evaluate), ELEMENT and STRESS_TYPE. Requires analysis results for the requested load case; on any failure the endpoint throws an error with a message, it does not return partial data. Sections in the response can be turned off via OUTPUT_OPTS (disabled items are simply absent); *_DIAGRAM flags additionally export each panel as a BMP file and then EXPORT_PATH (existing directory) and OUTPUT_NAME (base file name) become required. The response echoes the resolved load case, section name, element LENGTH, solver used (EXACT or APPROX_5POINT) and the LENGTH/FORCE units of the returned values.

TYPE.description: Load case type prefix (case-insensitive): ST static, CS construction stage, RS response spectrum, TH time history, CB..CBLN load combinations (general/steel/CFT/concrete/foundation/SRC/aluminum/steel-composite/seismic/linear-eval), NRS nonlinear response spectrum, ES/NES eccentricity spectrum, CN crane, EN envelope. HY, MV, SM, GI and PO cases are not supported.

NAME.description: Load case / combination name (without the type prefix), e.g. 'DL' for the case shown as 'ST: DL'.

STAGE_NAME.description: Construction stage name used as the evaluation context. Must NOT be an empty string when given. When TYPE=CS and STAGE_NAME is omitted, the stage/step the document currently stands on is used.

STEP_INDEX.description: Step index within the stage, 1 or greater. Allowed only together with STAGE_NAME, or when TYPE is CS (fails with 'STEP_INDEX needs STAGE_NAME unless TYPE is CS').

MINMAX.description: Envelope selection for enveloped results (case-insensitive): NORMAL single value, MAX/MIN envelope extreme, ALL both.

ELEMENT.description: Beam element number to analyze, 1 or greater.

STRESS_TYPE.description: Stress type for the longitudinal/cross-section stress outputs (case-insensitive). Also determines which force/moment COMPS are allowed: Normal -> Fx/My/Mz; Tauxy -> Fy/Mx; Tauxz -> Fz/Mx; VonMises/MaxShear/Princmax/Princmin -> all six.

ELEM_POS_RATIO.description: Position along the element from I-end (0.0) to J-end (1.0) at which the 'user' values (DUSER/FUSER/MUSER/SIG_USER and cross-section stress) are evaluated.

COMPS.description: Force/moment components to include (case-insensitive), a NON-EMPTY subset of the set allowed by STRESS_TYPE (see STRESS_TYPE); a component outside the allowed set is rejected. Omit to use the full allowed set. Mb/Mt/Mw (7th-DOF) are not selectable.

OUTPUT_OPTS.description: Which result sections to return and which diagrams to export as BMP files. Omit to return all sections and export nothing.

LONG_SECT_STRESS.description: Return Longitudinal Section Stress section. For tapered sections only the value at ELEM_POS_RATIO is available (SIG_I/J/MAX/MIN are omitted).

CROSS_SECT_STRESS.description: Return Cross Section Stress section (stress at section outline points at ELEM_POS_RATIO).

APPLIED_FORCE_MOM.description: Return Applied Forces/Moments section (Fx..Mz at ELEM_POS_RATIO; Mb/Mt/Mw are always 0.0).

CROSS_SECT_POINTS.description: Extra user cross-section points to evaluate; NON-EMPTY and allowed only when CROSS_SECT_STRESS is true (fails with 'CROSS_SECT_POINTS requires CROSS_SECT_STRESS to be true').

items.description: Point in the section's local y/z frame measured from the section center.

DISP_DZ_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Displacement Dz panel as a BMP file.

SHEAR_FZ_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Shear Force Fz panel as a BMP file.

MOMENT_MY_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Bending Moment My panel as a BMP file.

DISP_DY_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Displacement Dy panel as a BMP file.

SHEAR_FY_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Shear Force Fy panel as a BMP file.

MOMENT_MZ_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Bending Moment Mz panel as a BMP file.

LONG_STRESS_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Longitudinal Section Stress panel as a BMP file.

CROSS_STRESS_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Cross Section Stress panel as a BMP file.

APPLIED_FM_DIAGRAM.description: Export the Applied Forces/Moments panel as a BMP file.

EXPORT_PATH.description: [any *_DIAGRAM=true] Existing directory the BMP diagram files are written to. Required (non-empty) when any *_DIAGRAM flag is true; the saved file paths are returned in the response FILES array.

OUTPUT_NAME.description: [any *_DIAGRAM=true] Output file base name without path or extension. Required (non-empty) when any *_DIAGRAM flag is true.
